shows.title: The river's year
shows.label: the river's year
shows.description: Plays the recorded river through a year that only turns forward: still white winter, green spring rain, a golden summer torrent, a rust-and-mud autumn. Automatic mode turns one season a minute; dynamic mode lets the people counter warm it toward summer as the room fills; manual picks a target season and intensity. Runs on bitcube alone, with no internet. Control page on port 9981.
inputs: river library (recorded clip at three speeds, on bitcube's disk)
shows.last_change: Build script reads its calibration pin from shows.json (no newest-map-wins)

shows.title: The live river
shows.label: the live river
shows.description: The river as it is right now: the river camera streams over Starlink and fills the ropes and screens, with a time-slice memory and sparkle on moving water. Dave's AI agent on Modal watches the room and the river, and every few minutes sets the palette, flow, rain and gain; his canvas plays as a faint layer. If the river feed drops it falls back to rain. Needs the internet, the river site and Modal.
inputs: Dave's agent on Modal (scene and camera reactions)
shows.last_change: Build script reads its calibration pin from shows.json (no newest-map-wins)

shows.title: Baseline template
shows.description: The starting point for a new visualization: the river camera (with the recorded clip as fallback) and the gallery camera in, the river out on the four HUB75 screens and down the 20 ropes through the pinned calibration. Copy it to make your own show file; it is not meant to be shown to visitors.
shows.last_change: Built and verified on bitcube; its build reads the calibration pin from shows.json

shows.title: Combined v0
shows.description: Live river with recorded fallback, Gavin's fixed summer base and Dave's additive canvas. Auto recognizes two river-camera views and selects masked, shadow-lifted crops; manual framing and Original bypass remain available. The four screens can fade independently among the current look, Gavin's seasonal treatment on live footage, and his processed three-speed river recording, with manual blending or cycles spread across the screens. The ropes keep the current Combined look. Mission control saves framing, overlay and screen settings. No audio.
inputs: Dave's Modal canvas and mirrored scene
gallery camera (available, not used in v0)
shows.last_change: Spread screen looks around the full cycle from startup; add evenly-spread preset and wider phase spacing

shows.title: Combined with Modal Input Selector
shows.description: Will's Combined v0 (live river, summer look, framing, screen-look cycle) with one Modal input chosen in mission control: off; Dave's canvas added on top (today's look); Dave's scene recolouring the river with its palette and steering speed, density, brightness and turbulence; or Modal Frames, Dave's own pictures for each screen and the ropes, journeyed to in OKLCH and rippled by the live river. One strength slider; switching fades over 4 s without a restart. Stale Modal data fades back to plain Combined.
inputs: Dave's Modal canvas, mirrored scene and reflexes
shows.last_change: Created: cloned Combined v0 and added the Modal input selector (off / canvas / scene / frames)
